title_as_printed: Experimentally Determined MgCl2 Densities Compared with Those Calculated from Regression Equations
pressure_note: abstract: densities measured at 1 atm (no pressure value in tables)

value.what: measured density of the aqueous solution (average of several determinations)

composition.other_species: pure water (deionized, distilled); m = 0.00 rows are measured salt-free reference densities (Kell water densities were used by the authors only to calibrate the oscillating-tube densimeter)

extra_unmapped: rho calc g/cm3 (from the authors' polynomial regression, derived)
notes: Printed as side-by-side blocks 25/30/35 C then 40/45 C; stacked in order 25,30,35,40,45 with one label row per temperature. m is molality (mol solute per kg H2O) per the text under eq 2.

row_held.reason: salt-free row: the paper states 'the densities of pure water were taken from Kell', a calculated reference, not a measurement (found by the inter-source consensus: identical values in two sources, 2026-10-03)
